memory_candidates.content: In a shared/concurrent multi-agent working tree, verify a build-free CI-facing check script's exit code against a detached `git worktree add --detach <path> HEAD` checkout, not the live local dev tree -- the local tree can carry always-populated runtime artifacts (e.g. a generated data/ directory with zero tracked files) that mask a clean-checkout-only false positive the CI runner would actually hit.

check-module-invariants.sh's --emit-inventory has no per-file/per-target scoping flag: it rewrites every registered <!-- BEGIN GENERATED: inventory --> block in the repo in one pass. In a concurrent multi-agent working tree, do not run it to fix one file's stale table when other registered blocks are mid-edit by other tasks -- the safer choice is a targeted hand-fix of just the counts/rows owned by the current task, even when the generator-conversion alternative would be architecturally nicer.
